summary: Evaluate the ES1D example interpolation on explicitly scaled selected coordinates and frequencies.

identity.definition: winterp=interp1(rex*pas,rez*wws[:,0,0],coordinate) using native interp1 defaults. This is linear interpolation of already selected data, not a dispersion solve. Out-of-range NaN is preserved.
identity.model: Uniform magnetized, nonrelativistic charged Gaussian species with optional gyrotropic loss-cone mixture; B0 along signed z and k=(kx,0,kz).
identity.geometry: Cartesian k=(kx,0,kz), B0 along signed z; non-spatial representation for pole/partition operators.
identity.coordinates: SI angular frequency rad/s and wave number m^-1; normalized source scan/selection quantities are labeled explicitly.
identity.boundary: Uniform/local plane-wave response; no spatial boundary-value problem or nonlinear saturation.
assumptions: Caller retains the explicit truncation, state provenance and normalization.

inputs.name: state
inputs.description: NativeResult or its state mapping produced by the named predecessor. Scalar numeric fields are usually 1x1 native arrays; row/column singleton dimensions are preserved. Scientific numeric transport is float64/complex128; inactive fields are empty arrays, never fabricated zeros.
inputs.units: mixed; physical dimensions recorded by state fields
inputs.constraints: Must contain the complete compatible predecessor state; handcrafted inconsistent fields are outside the qualified composition.

inputs.name: coordinate
inputs.description: Interpolation coordinate on explicitly scaled rex*pas axis.
inputs.constraints: Source interp1 behavior; out-of-range values produce NaN rather than fabricated extrapolation.

inputs.name: rex
inputs.constraints: None consumes state.rex; units follow the selected example convention.

inputs.name: rez
inputs.constraints: None consumes state.rez; no automatic conversion to SI is inferred.

outputs.name: winterp
outputs.constraints: Accessible in returned NativeResult.state; scientific meaning applies only to a compatible completed predecessor. Empty inactive arrays are preserved.

preconditions: Monotone interpolation abscissa and compatible selected first-surface data.
supported: Monotone interpolation abscissa and compatible selected first-surface data.
excluded: Global nonlinear plasma evolution and a guarantee of unique physical mode identification.

failure_semantics.invalid_input: Declared Python guards raise ValueError; incomplete or inconsistent state may raise KeyError or a native indexing/domain error. No silent physical-model substitution.
failure_semantics.runtime_failure: NativeExecutionError records unavailable/failed/timed-out Octave execution. source_output additionally raises SourceOutputError carrying the result and receipt computed so far when its caught scientific terminal fails.
failure_semantics.nonconvergence: Eigen/interpolation/selection native failure is observable; no failed root is converted to a successful mode. This operator does not certify global root convergence.
failure_semantics.partial_results: Completed NativeResult carries immutable state and receipt. source_output failures expose partial artifacts through exception.result; other failed native calls do not promise a completed scientific state.

example.description: A self-contained example that uses the packaged native resources and raw Octave; no network access is required.
example.code:
import numpy as np
from scirel.kinetic.pdrk import magnetized as m, workflows as w
st={'pas':np.array([.1,.2,.3]),'wws':np.array([1.,2.,3.]).reshape(3,1,1),'rex':1.,'rez':1.}
r=m.interpolate_selected_dispersion(st,coordinate=.2)
assert np.allclose(r.state['winterp'],2.)
example.expected: NOT_RUN (environment): the example requires GNU Octave on Linux amd64; this macOS checkout has no octave executable, so NativeExecutionError is expected and no scientific result is claimed.

scope: Native interp1 behavior, including out-of-range NaN, is covered by direct evidence.
Canonical example checks a manufactured exact interpolation value; no plasma dispersion root accuracy follows.
verification.evidence_ceiling: Direct contract tests and the declared finite cases bound the relation only where their numeric gates apply; native execution requires GNU Octave on Linux amd64 and is NOT_RUN in this macOS checkout.
known_limitations: Local technical development; human scientific endorsement and publication clearance remain pending.
Finite harmonic N and rational-pole J approximations require independent convergence checks for a new physical regime.
Passing bounded response, state and backward-error tests does not establish unique physical-mode tracking, all-root forward accuracy or visual acceptance.
The native example and full verification require GNU Octave on Linux amd64; the current macOS run is NOT_RUN.

references: Xie and Xiao, PDRK: A General Kinetic Dispersion Relation Solver for Magnetized Plasma, Plasma Science and Technology 18 (2016).
